correctness.rationale: The origin and unit coordinate vertices imply full dimension N=n²+2n. The complete Faenza–Ferrarini positive-facet H-description was checked directly against primary Theorem 2/equation (7). Nonnegativity forces any radius-r center coordinate c_i≥r, making r≤b/(||a||1+||a||2) for every positive upper facet and uniform center r*1 attainable at the minimum. Degree denominator n+1+sqrt(n+1); balanced t-biclique denominator t+2+sqrt(1+2/t) strictly increases to n. Lifted coefficients yield S=H0+τm,H=H0+(2τ+τ²)m,B=u+aτ; (u+2)B−S=τ b(u−a)≥0 and positivity of (u+2)B²−H eliminate every unbalanced facet strictly. Comparing bounds gives sharp n=2,3 vs n≥4. Tight whole-biclique or all degree normals plus coordinate lower bounds force unique center; no other contacts. Independent bounded lifted-family n≤30 check and inspected LP script; analytic inequality handles all n.
